prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Redesign for Path Selection: Redesign the path selection screen into a card layout with distinct visuals for premade pet adoption vs custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "card", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Journey", "body": "Select a ready-to-adopt companion or build a unique pet from your own photos."}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Reset Warning Hint on Sign-In: Add clear inline hint text on the sign-in screen warning users to use the same account to keep their existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary account to preserve existing pets and saved custom data."}}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Name and Trait Review Screen: Add a dedicated pet naming and trait summary screen right before the adoption certificate is generated.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_summary", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_summary": {"headline": "Review Your Companion Details", "body": "Confirm your pet's name and personality before official adoption.", "button_label": "Confirm & Create", "layout": "card"}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In Right Before Waiting Generation: Move the sign-in screen after pet choice and photo upload, immediately prior to the rendering waiting screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Render Check Flow: Insert a desktop preview check flow during the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay permissions before finish.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_check", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_check": {"headline": "Desktop Visibility Test", "body": "Verifying your screen permissions to display your pet seamlessly on top of desktop windows.", "button_label": "Test Desktop Render", "layout": "centered"}}
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Shortcut and Control Banner on Final Welcome: Update headline and body on home_intro to clearly explain system tray access, hotkeys, and how to summon/hide the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "body": "Look for the pet icon in your system tray to access settings, hide/show the companion, or trigger interactions."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Story Scroll Layout on Waiting Screen: Switch the waiting screen to a story scroll layout displaying pet lore and setup status while generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "story_scroll", "show_progress": true, "headline": "Bringing Your Companion to Life..."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Pet Care Starter Pack Incentive on Pick Friend: Display a badge component highlighting an included starter accessory pack with every chosen pet.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Care Starter Pack", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop System Tray Alert Notification on Waiting: Add an explicit system notification flag on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You can minimize this window. We'll alert you when your pet is ready on your desktop."}}
9: [finish, redesign] Full-Bleed Layout Redesign of Home Intro Screen: Transform the home_intro completion screen into a full-bleed layout featuring interactive mascot elements and clear tray guidance.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Welcome to Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is now active. Right-click the system tray icon anytime for controls.", "button_label": "Start Interacting"}}
